text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation being here. The clean, modern architecture of the glass conference room gives an impression of order and potential, as if ideas are waiting to be exchanged. Moving to the vibrant display area, the bold colors and the focus on 'R+D' evoke excitement about innovation and the pursuit of knowledge. I am both a witness and a participant in this space of creation—invited to reflect on how new ideas come to life and how I, too, am shaped by my environment.
